title: Q3 comparator mismatch record
description: One structured mismatch returned by comparator.ts's compareFeeds. A candidate for the interface Direction 2's review entry asks for -- not a claimed shared interface. Only vector/key/field are required: for a presence mismatch (field "presence") the absent side is undefined in memory, so a JSON round-trip drops that key (and a null actual row stays null); requiring expected/actual would make round-tripped presence mismatches fail their own schema. This validator subset has no if/then, so conditional-required per field value is not expressible -- expected/actual are optional here.
